ios.desc:
Track your spending with Expenses

Expenses focuses on what matters: tracking your money simply and privately. Log expenses and income in any currency, scan receipts to enter details faster, organize spending by category and merchant, and understand your habits with intuitive stats and spending trends. With iCloud, your data stays in sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. You can also share a sheet with others to manage expenses together seamlessly.

• Featured by Apple on the App Store
• Used by people in 100+ countries

Start effortlessly
There is no learning curve and no account to create. Just open the app and start adding your expenses or income in seconds. When you travel, you can add expenses in different currencies. Exchange rates update automatically for major currencies, and you can set custom rates whenever you need.

Scan receipts faster
Capture receipts and turn them into expense entries with less manual typing. Expenses helps you keep accurate records while staying focused on your spending, not data entry.

Organize with categories and merchants
Create and customize categories that fit your life, then track where your money goes by merchant. Whether you want to review grocery trips, subscriptions, restaurants, or travel costs, merchant support makes your spending easier to understand.

Discover where your money really goes
See the bigger picture with visual trends over time and detailed breakdowns by category and merchant. Turn your spending data into actionable insights that help you make smarter financial decisions.

Share and collaborate
Planning a trip? Managing a household? Invite others to share a sheet and track expenses together in real time.

Privacy built in
Expenses is private by design. No sign-ups and no personal data collection. Your information stays on your device or in iCloud, always under your control.

Import and export your data
You can export your expenses as a CSV file anytime for backup or further analysis. Expenses also supports importing existing data from CSV, making it easy to migrate from other tools or bring in previous records.

Designed for everyone
Expenses works beautifully on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro with:
• Dark Mode for comfortable viewing
• Widgets for quick expense entry
• Shortcuts automation support
• Full accessibility features
• Instant sync across all your devices

Download Expenses today and see where your money goes.
